# ListInsetText

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:list-inset-text` · Kerf UI · component · Structure

Gives selected physical sides of bare text the content-item geometry so it lines up with bordered items.

## When to use

Apply the full 8px margin + 1px transparent border + 8px padding to all physical sides of bare text by default, or only the sides selected with the canonical Sides contract.

- Line a plain text element up with bordered .kui-content items — it adds the 8px margin, 1px transparent border, and 8px padding the text lacks.

**Not when:**

- Do not use it to wrap an interactive control (use ListInsetControl), or a component that already owns its content-item geometry.

**Alternatives:**

- [ListInsetControl](./list-inset-control.md) (nearest)

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/list-inset-text` — exports `ListInsetText`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/list-inset-text` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/list-inset-text.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/list-inset-text`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuilist-inset-text) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** the text content.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: self · border: self · padding: self (layout role: structure). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

## Accessibility

- A layout wrapper only; it adds no role or name.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-list-inset-text`.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and forced component dimensions (`KUI-L005`).
